consumer_reviews.source_snippet: **Given:** Countable choice for the scattering measures. A length $a>0$, a reduced mass $\mu>0$, a positive energy $E>0$, with $[a]=\ell$, $[\mu]=\mathsf M$ and $[E]=[U_0]=\mathsf M\ell^2\tau^{-2}$; the speeds $v_\infty,v_{\mathrm{in}}$ have units $\ell\tau^{-1}$ and the angle parameters are dimensionless. Also adopt the following separate **refracting-shell model**: the label moves freely for $r\ne a$; at $r=a$ the example-specific radial contact rule preserves the tangential velocity component and conserves energy with a potential drop $U_0>0$ inside, so the speed inside is $v_{\mathrm{in}}=\sqrt{v_\infty^2+2U_0/\mu}$ with $v_\infty=\sqrt{2E/\mu}$. Choose the index $n=\frac32$ so that $v_{\mathrm{in}}=\frac32v_\infty$ and $U_0=\frac54E$. This interface rule is adopted here and is not supplied by [[post-cm15-impulse]] clause (ii), which covers only finite-mass collinear two-label restitution. The incoming motion is a straight line with impact parameter $b\ge0$ and speed $v_\infty$. The interface rule is applied at transverse crossings; at grazing $b=a$ adopt the free continuation. Separately, for the genuine smooth witness use the central model on time window $\mathbb R$ with $u=0$ and two equal label masses $2\mu$.
